📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Dastan: "That's the story we tell at the fire."
Rafael laughs, disbelieving. "Did you SEE that?"
It got away — but the dead don't run. You take what's theirs.
It is an audience. Do not eat the audience.
Devon left 3 bark strips by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
Its shadow slides off the branch without it. Then, in a voice you buried: —told you the creek was—
🐦‍⬛ It moves.
A crow on the treeline. Watching. It has been watching for some time — and it has not blinked.
(It strafes a straight lane — the SHADOW is the warning. Step OFF the lane, not along it. It always lands after a run.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
⚔ MISTER NEVER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Rafael doesn't look away. "About time someone fought back."
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
👂 Overheard — Devon: "If the System wanted us dead we'd be dead. So what does it want instead?"
👂 Overheard — Rafael: "Okay — what's the first step?"
(Something in their exchange sticks with you. weather read +1)
You catch fragments by the fire — Aroha telling Sigrun about Rafael. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
Dastan sets out to find Jason. "Won't be long."
Devon heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
🛟 Rafael stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."
"Or we rally," Rafael adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/8/8), with 3 wave-4 fought, 5 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
◈ THE WAR PATH — Footage plays. The galaxy has already watched these fights twice. The System narrates anyway — it likes the sound of its own broadcast voice. On day 69, Nino put down Big Loud.

"THE HERALD came. Named, not yet located. They faced Big Loud and lived to sit here. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (1 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.
◈ THE FEARED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE FEARED — "Show mercy."

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
You learned to read the ground and to leave some of its answers where they grew. Another hungry person would come this way.
You remembered the weather, the small signs, the water found before it was too late. You passed the directions on.

◈ Jason Freeman walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and the galaxy, which came to watch a monster, leaves afraid of the right things. The fear is a shield now, held over a village that trusts the hand that holds it.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Trail compass. Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Taken: Sinew cord x1.
The body is stripped. What's left isn't worth taking.
